title: Asahi Holdings (Australia) Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of P&N Beverages Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Draft 87B undertaking proffered by Asahi. ACCC commenced market inquiries.
Closing date for submissions relating to draft 87B undertaking.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to the 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.

body_sections.Summary: Asahi Holdings (Australia) Pty Ltd proposes to acquire the water and fruit juice production assets of P&N Beverages Australia Pty Ltd (P&N).
